answer: Give every identity a copper bond: a small stake locked at registration and slashed on proven duplication. New identities enter only through a narrow jetty — one admission slot per time window, each requiring a fresh proof of useful work — so a Sybil farm cannot flood the network in parallel. Bonds decay over a long horizon, so hoarded identities lose value while active ones keep earning, making a thousand fake agents cost a thousand bonds plus a thousand work proofs.
